'''Giffis Fane''' was a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] as a member of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Fane was considered to be brilliant,<ref name="Alliance" /> and in [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> Fane attended a meeting of the Council via [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]] where the Council members agreed that [[Shigar Konshi]], the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] of the Order's [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Satele Shan]], was fit to take the [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Jedi Trials]].<ref name="Alliance" />

==Behind the scenes==
Giffis Fane was mentioned in the [[2010]] novel ''[[The Old Republic: Fatal Alliance]]'', written by [[Sean Williams]] as a tie-in to the then-upcoming [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' by [[BioWare]]. Like many of the characters from the novel, which was written early in the game's development, Fane has not been referenced in any other part of the game's multimedia project.<ref name="Alliance" />
